articles.title: Apple picks up Nate Gatten as new head of government affairs
articles.description: Apple has signed up Nate Gatten to become its new head of government affairs, a move that could help the company work more with the Trump administration. Nate Gatten - Image Credit: American Airlines Apple is undergoing a number of changes in the short term, in preparation for the CEO transition from Tim Cook to John Ternus on September 1. One day before the switch, Apple will be installing a new vice president. According to a memo from SVP and General Counsel Jennifer Newstead seen by Bloomberg , Nate Gatten will be taking over as vice president of Government Affairs. Current head of government affairs Nick Ammann will move down the corporate ladder one rung, and report to Gatten. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

articles.title: TSMC and Taiwan researchers engineered an interface only 0.42 nanometers thick to improve next-generation MoS2 transistors
articles.description: Researchers from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and TSMC have developed a new interface design for atomically thin transistors. They created a 0.42-nanometre aluminium oxide layer between monolayer MoS2 and a hafnium oxide dielectric. The design helped the transistors maintain strong electrical control and carrier transport while using an extremely thin insulating layer.
